CM CruiseMesh

Family messaging · offline-first

Text your family beyond the internet.

Text your family on a cruise ship—or anywhere coverage is unreliable—over a delay-tolerant Bluetooth mesh, with end-to-end encryption and an optional internet relay when someone gets online.

View on GitHub Read the design
📡

Phone-to-phone mesh

BLE store-and-forward carries messages when Wi‑Fi and cellular are gone. Minutes of delay are fine.

🔒

End-to-end encrypted

Sealed envelopes only. Relays and strangers’ phones never see plaintext—including delivery receipts.

🌐

Optional internet relay

One device with a Wi‑Fi package becomes the family uplink. The mailbox is self-hostable on a cheap VPS.

How delivery works

  1. Direct contactWithin Bluetooth range of the recipient.
  2. Data muleA family member’s phone picks up your queued message and carries it until paths cross.
  3. Internet relayAny phone with network access syncs the family’s sealed queue through the relay.

Apps

Android (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose) and iOS (SwiftUI) clients live in the open-source repository. Shared cryptography and sync logic use a Rust core through UniFFI.

Early development: store listings are not public yet. Build from source for now.
